items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I was with Gil Evans and him. And we played records.

ctx.x: Yes, I've heard that. But I didn't know that his father did that upside-down thing.

Oh yeah. That was a thing, you know, to draw people's attention. He never talked about his father. Never once. He never talked about his family. Never. I was at his house, and we had a big fight... I was with Gil Evans and him. And we played records. And some guy downstairs, some relative, started raising hell. And Lester got real mad. He said, 'We're movin' out. We're going to Teddy's house.' And we did. We made about three trips, and we went to Teddy's.
He didn't get along with his father.
